api_response.title: Saiyaara (film)
api_response.extract: Saiyaara (transl. Planet) is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language musical romantic drama film directed by Mohit Suri. Produced by Yash Raj Films, it is loosely based on the 2004 South Korean film A Moment to Remember. Saiyaara stars debutants Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda in the lead roles of a singer-songwriter duo who fall in love. Originally planned as a spiritual sequel to Suri's Aashiqui 2, creative differences led to the project being reworked into a standalone film under Yash Raj Films.
